newsitem.title: MEXICO: Benavides sees Q4 revenues above Q3's.
newsitem.headline: Benavides sees Q4 revenues above Q3's.

text.p: Farmacias Benavides expects its Q4 revenues to improve from Q3 due to seasonal factors, a company director told Reuters on Monday.

"We expect fourth quarter sales to increase a little over the third quarter. The fourth quarter usually sees a seasonal peak, and we expect it to do so again this year," said Benavides Investor Relations Director Martha Martinez.
Benavides posted Q3 revenues of 506 million pesos, which were up 0.4 percent in year-ago terms but down four percent from Q2.
"We expected the third quarter to be a little weak, because of the general economic situation and the lack of recovery in purchasing power," Martinez added.
